does: Fills the TaskInfo and the TargetingInfo of the spell task under the cursor: the main damage type, the roll conditions' chance through CalculateModifiableSpellRollChance, the chance without advantage at +0xD8 and the shown chance clamped 1..99 at +0xD9.

a count-only probe over 5 s of the host holding Target_MainHandAttack on a goblin shows about 165 calls, one per frame at a 30 fps cap
